product.title: Singapore: Chinese, Indian & Malay Quarters, Culture & Food Tour

description.text: In Singapore, this small-group food and culture walk covers Chinatown, Little India, and Kampong Glam with a fourth-generation Singapore-Chinese-Peranakan host. The published 5.5-hour window includes street food from UNESCO-inscribed hawker centres plus a Sultan Mosque stop, with coffee, lunch, dinner snacks, and drinks listed among inclusions. Groups are capped at eight. Central hotel or MRT pickup is offered for a 9:00 am start in Chinatown. The route stays on the three historic quarters rather than a Marina Bay night circuit. The format suits visitors who want a guided three-culture tasting day without assembling hawker and mosque timing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on Chinatown, Little India, Kampong Glam, and Sultan Mosque that shape this outing rather than a private car day.
